title: Weather Bureau employees see four metallic discs
summary: Merrick tells of Weather Bureau employees see four metallic discs, about 19 April 1947 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: two Weather Bureau employees uh observed four metallic discs flat on the bottom, domed on the top.

plain: A researcher named Merrick, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that on 19 April 1947 two employees of the Weather Bureau, the US government's weather service, saw four metal discs that were flat on the bottom and domed on top. He brings it up next to the famous sighting by a man named Kenneth Arnold later that year, as a sign that people were seeing such discs even before Arnold's report.
